info.name: Syrian Adv Landing API
info.description: Postman collection for Syrian Adv Landing APIs, split into Customer and Admin flows.

request.description: Customer login. Returns access_token with account_type=customer.
Customer registration. Creates a customer account.
Returns the available cities.
Returns the available regions.
Returns templates with base prices and landing price if configured.
Returns the available printing types. No token is required.
Returns active landing page texts grouped by section. No token is required.

response.name: Success Example

request.description: Returns road signs from the upstream service using the provided filters.
Lists all landing page content rows for admin or superadmin management.
Creates a page content row that can later be activated or deactivated.
Updates the text value, section, key, locale, or active state.
Marks a page content row as active so it appears on the public landing page.
Marks a page content row as inactive so it is hidden from the public landing page.
Deletes a page content row from the landing content table.
Returns the authenticated customer's bookings.
Creates a booking for the authenticated customer.
Returns the authenticated customer's conversations. Use status=open or status=closed if needed.
Creates or reuses the customer's open conversation. Body is optional for customers.
Returns messages for a conversation that belongs to the authenticated customer.
Sends a new message in the conversation.
Admin login. Returns access_token with account_type=admin when the user has an admin role.
Logs in via the main Laravel site superadmin endpoint and returns a local landing JWT with account_type=superadmin. Save the token in superadminToken.
Lists the landing-page admins managed by the superadmin.
Gets a single landing admin by id.
Creates a landing-page admin account and assigns the admin role locally.
Updates a landing-page admin account.
Deletes a landing-page admin account.
Returns active news items without requiring a token.

Lists templates with base prices and landing prices for admin management.
Updates the landing page price for a template without changing the base product prices.
Lists all news items for admin and superadmin.

item.name: Create Or Reuse Conversation For Customer

request.description: Creates or reuses an open conversation for a specific customer.
Returns messages for a conversation visible to the authenticated admin.
Sends a message in an existing conversation. Use customer_id with the socket event when you want the server to open or reuse a conversation for that customer.
